name: everest_wide
purpose: Context layer for the Everest summit gag.
gaps: Colour (round 3, 2026-11-09): HLS 30 m from the pre-monsoon high-sun window (10 April-10 June 2022-2024, the 6 clearest days, median): near-black texels 6.3 % to 0.03 %, on north faces above 5,000 m 8.6 % to 0.07 % (was October-December, low sun). The monsoon months are cloud-covered and the HLS Fmask calls the high snowfields cloud (half the pixels above 6,500 m never clear), so they are not used. Light from the south still reads best (preset everest); AO tangent.
